messages:
Amelia: Hey team — heads up: Elena's birthday is next Thursday (May 6). Want to do something low-key in-office? Quick options: 1) bagel breakfast + balloons 2) surprise Zoom + e-gift 3) cake/cupcakes in the fridge 4) donation in her name. React with :one:/:two:/:three:/:four: to vote. Also if you're in-office and can bring something, reply here. Budget ~ $60. @people-ops-bot can remind on Tue.
Jordan: :one: for bagels! Also she mentioned she's dairy-free. Gluten-free bagel options ok?
Sophie: :four: donation sounds lovely. +1 for remote folks to chip in.
Noah: :three: cake but vegan please. I can grab vegan cupcakes if someone covers $20.
Amelia: Noted dietary needs (dairy-free/vegan/gluten-free). I'll coordinate catering. Who can bring balloons/decor? @Jordan maybe you can pick up balloons? :partyparrot: 
Jordan: I can pick up balloons and GF bagels. Happy to swing by the bakery Wed morning.
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: Elena birthday reminder on 2026-05-06 09:00. Remindees: @Amelia @Jordan @Sophie @Noah
Sophie: If we do donation, let's put a short note in the card. Who wants to add a message? I'll draft.
Noah: I can cover $20 toward cupcakes now — Venmo @noah. If we end up reimbursing, I'll keep the receipt.
Amelia: Okay tally so far: Bagels (Jordan pickup), Balloons (Jordan), Cupcakes (Noah partial), Donation (Sophie champion). I'll open a Google sheet for signups and dietary notes: https://tinyurl.com/elena-bday-signup
Jordan: :thumbsup: Cool. I'll add GF bagel options to the sheet.
Sophie: Thanks everyone. Elena loves plants — lowkey gift plus card sounds perfect.
Noah: Also suggesting a 5-min "happy birthday" Zoom at 10:30 for remote folks if we do in-office. Thoughts?
Amelia: Love that. We'll do a quick Zoom at 10:30 and leave cake in the fridge for in-office folks. Final poll: react to confirm plan. :tada:
